Why a system

Body skin is different. Your care should be too.

The skin below the neck faces friction, sweat, thicker texture, delayed pigment fading, larger treatment areas, shaving, workouts, occlusion, stretch, barrier stress, and body changes. PYPER is built for that reality.

01

Larger treatment areas

Backs, legs, and torsos need dosing and formats built for scale — not face-sized tubes.

02

Friction & sweat

Clothing, workouts, and occlusion stress body skin in ways facial routines never address.

03

Body acne & ingrowns

Breakouts and ingrowns on the back, chest, and shoulders need body-specific actives.

04

Texture & pigmentation

Thicker skin and slower turnover mean KP and dark marks fade on a different timeline.

05

GLP-1 body changes & maintenance

Weight change reshapes skin quality, texture, and laxity — and needs ongoing support.

Membership

The support layer around treatment.

PYPER Membership is required for GLP-1 patients and optional for body-care patients who want additional support. Membership includes The PYPER Method Guide, GLP-1 lifestyle support, body-skin education, progress tools, partner perks, maintenance planning, and access to the private members-only Discord. GLP-1 patients receive medication access together with membership support when clinically appropriate.
